carriers.postalCodeRequired: Valid postal code is required (5-10 digits)
carriers.phoneRequired: Valid phone number is required (min 9 digits)
carriers.inpostPickupHint: Pickup-booking settings for inpost_courier_* services. Locker services don't need this.
carriers.inpostDispatchPointIdHint: ShipX dispatch_point_id of a pre-registered pickup point. When set, the inline shipper address above is not used for dispatch orders.
carriers.inpostPickupDisabledHint: Skip the daily dispatch-order job (use when you have a standing daily-pickup arrangement).
carriers.inpostSendingMethodHint: How parcels are handed over to InPost. Drop-off methods skip the courier pickup booking; the API rate also depends on this choice.
carriers.inpostDropoffPointHint: Required when Sending method = Drop at Paczkomat. Example: WAW721M.
carriers.glsSettingsHint: Label format and pickup-receipt behaviour. The sender address above is sent with every consignment.
carriers.glsPfcHint: Optional GLS cost-centre id stamped on every consignment.
carriers.glsIntegratorIdHint: Only for software vendors with a GLS-issued integrator id. Leave empty for a normal account.
carriers.glsAutoPickupDisabledHint: Skip the automatic end-of-day pickup receipt. Note that a receipt is irreversible: it moves parcels out of the preparing box and they can no longer be cancelled.
carriers.glsTrackingHint: Tracking is a separate GLS system with its own Uni-Portal (your-gls.eu) credentials. Without them parcels get labels but never report a status.
carriers.dhlMultiparcelHint: How orders with several boxes are shipped.
carriers.dhlSupportMultiparcelHint: When off, an order with multiple boxes is sent as separate shipments (one waybill per box). Products are distributed across boxes by weight for customs.
carriers.dhlCustomsHint: Used for shipments outside the EU customs union. Per-product HS code / origin take priority; the defaults below fill the gaps.
carriers.dhlCustomsTypeHint: Simplified needs no EORI/invoice. Individual requires EORI, NIP, VAT and an invoice.
carriers.dhlCustomsDefaultTariffHint: Fallback used for products without their own HS code. Enter the full code (e.g. 3304300000); it is trimmed to what each destination accepts — Ireland takes the 6-digit heading.
carriers.dhlCustomsDefaultOriginHint: ISO-2 code (e.g. PL). Fallback for products without their own origin.
carriers.dhlExpressServiceHint: API Key goes in Username and API Secret in Password — both from developer.dhl.com. Account number is your DHL Express shipper account, a different value.
carriers.dhlExpressShipperCountryHint: ISO-2 code of the origin country. Decides which shipments count as domestic.
carriers.dhlExpressContentDescriptionHint: Printed on the waybill for every shipment from this carrier.
carriers.dhlExpressTimezoneHint: IANA zone (e.g. Europe/Warsaw). DHL reads the shipping date in local time and rejects times in the past.
carriers.dhlExpressMultiparcelHint: DHL Express carries multiple boxes on one waybill to any destination. Turn off to send one waybill per box.
carriers.dhlExpressPickupLabelsHint: The label is returned only once, when the shipment is created — DHL cannot re-issue it.
carriers.dhlExpressRequestPickup: Book a courier on shipment creation
carriers.dhlExpressRequestPickupHint: Leave off if the account has a standing daily pickup.
carriers.dhlExpressPickupCloseTimeHint: Latest time the courier can collect, as HH:MM.
carriers.dhlExpressLabelTemplateHint: Choose the thermal format only if labels print on a label printer.
carriers.dhlExpressRequestInvoiceHint: DHL builds the invoice alongside the label for shipments that clear customs.
carriers.dhlExpressPaperlessTradeHint: Sends the customs invoice electronically instead of in a wallet on the parcel. Applied only to shipments that clear customs.
carriers.dhlExpressBypassPlt: Fall back to paper on lanes without PLT
carriers.dhlExpressBypassPltHint: Off: a destination that does not support PLT is rejected. On: DHL accepts it and prints paper documents instead.
carriers.dhlExpressCustomsHint: Applied to destinations outside the EU customs union.
carriers.dhlExpressIncotermHint: DDP bills duties and taxes to your account instead of the receiver.
